comment: Terms for values held in Zotero's Extra field as 'Key: Value' lines (CSL variables, Zotero-Cita, etc.). Shared by all item types; an item type file may contain its own 'extra' section with the same structure, whose entries replace the shared ones of the same key. Keys are matched case-insensitively and ignore spaces/hyphens/underscores. Each field or creator entry uses the same syntax as the 'fields' section of an item type file (a term, a list of terms, or an object with terms/type/language/pipeline); per-key defaults such as the Wikidata URI handling live in field_defaults.json. Values in Extra never override a value already in the matching Zotero field. 'types' maps 'Type: <CSL type>' to resource classes and overrides the class from the item type. Creator values may be written 'Last || First'.
